description: A modern, animated and immersive HUD overhaul for Minecraft Fabric with widgets, themes and dynamic effects.

mods.name: PulseHUD
mods.description: A modern, animated, immersive, and dynamic HUD overhaul mod for Minecraft.

releases.notes:
# PulseHUD 1.0.0

Initial public release.

## Features

- Complete vanilla HUD replacement
- Animated Health, Hunger, Armor and XP bars
- Modern glassmorphic hotbar
- 10+ draggable widgets
- Combat Mode
- Idle Mode
- Low Health Effects
- Water Overlay
- Hit Marker System
- 5 Themes
- Biome Reactive Colors
- Edit Mode
- ModMenu Integration
- Cloth Config Integration
- RealTimeClockUz Integration

Supported Minecraft versions:
- 1.21.1+
